clips.name: dlg_A_s1597
lines: [curious, warm] 罗密欧，为朱丽叶哭呢？
[sniffling, completely blank] ...Who is Juliet?
[sobbing dramatically] Rosaline! She hath forsworn to love!
[eager, still sniffling] Good friend, bear her this!
[firm, matter-of-fact] 我只拍，不插手。
clips.heard: 罗密歐,為朱莉耶哭呢?誰是朱莉耶?Rosaline, she had foresworn to love!Good friend, bear her this!我指拍,不插手!

clips.name: dlg_B_s1597
lines: [whispers] 为了罗瑟琳，混进仇家舞会。
[awestruck, breathless] Did my heart love till now?
[innocently curious] 那罗瑟琳呢？
[distracted, not listening] Who?
[teasing, friendly] 朱丽叶，看上谁了？
[urgent, bossy] Go ask his name.
[flat, polite but firm] 我只拍。
[whispers] 他是她家世仇的独子。
clips.heard: 为了罗瑟琳,混进仇家误会那罗瑟琳呢?朱利液,看上谁啦?我只拍,她是她家世仇的独子

clips.name: dlg_C_s1597
lines: [sighing, dreamy] O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?
[whispers] 对方哪里好？
[whispering, then bursting out] It is the east, and Juliet is the sun!
[whispers, deadpan] 现在是半夜。
[softly, dreamy] My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.
[deadpan, teasing] 才认识三小时吧？
[primly, very serious] It is too rash, too unadvised, too sudden.
[lovesick sigh] Romeo... Romeo...
[earnest, hand on heart] Lady, by yonder blessed moon I swear—
[cutting in, quick] O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon!
[brisk, decisive] Thy purpose marriage, send me word tomorrow!
[instantly, thrilled] At the hour of nine!
clips.heard: Oh Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo?對方哪裡好?It is the east, and Juliet is the sun.現在是半夜My bounty is as boundless as the sea.My love as deep.才認識三小時吧?It is too rash, too unadvised, too sudden.Oh Romeo, Romeo…Lady, by yonder blessed moon I swear.Oh swear not by the moon.The inconstant moon.By purpose marriage.Send me word tomorrow.At the hour of nine.

clips.name: dlg_D_s1597
lines: [dry, knowing] Wast thou with Rosaline?
[stiffly] I have forgot that name.
[wry, amused] Young men's love then lies not truly in their hearts, but in their eyes.
[amused, surprised] 那这婚您还证？
[slow, wise] Wisely and slow; they stumble that run fast.
[quietly, ominous] These violent delights have violent ends.
clips.heard: Was thou with Rosaline?I have forgot that name.Young men's love then lies not truly in their hearts, but in their eyes.那這婚姻還重?Wisely and slow.They stumble that run fast.These violent delights have violent ends.

clips.name: dlg_E_s1597
lines: [quietly, uneasy] 罗密欧？
[hollow, shaken] O, I am fortune's fool!
[whispers, shaken] 他刚杀了朱丽叶的表哥。
clips.heard: 罗密欧ohI am fortune's fool他刚杀了朱立叶的表哥

clips.name: dlg_F_s1597
lines: [whispers] 爸妈要她后天嫁别人。
[low, careful] Take thou this vial. No warmth, no breath, shall testify thou livest.
[low, reassuring] Two and forty hours, and then awake as from a pleasant sleep.
[fierce, impatient] Give me, give me! O, tell not me of fear!
[worried] 罗密欧知道吗？
[busy, writing] Shall Romeo by my letters know our drift.
[gently, hopeful] Thou. Wilt thou bear this to Romeo?
[small, hesitant] ……我只拍。
[softly, brave] Romeo, I come! This do I drink to thee.
clips.heard: 爸媽要他後天嫁別人羅密歐知道嗎我只拍

clips.name: dlg_G_s1597
lines: [whispers] 先到的消息：朱丽叶死了。
[raw, defiant] Then I defy you, stars!
[desperate hope] Hast thou no letters to me from the friar?
[barely audible] ……没有。
[flat, empty] No matter.
[urgent, cut off] 等等，她没——
[whispers, voice cracking] 她没死。他没听完。
clips.heard: 仙刀的消息 朱莉也死了没有等等 她没 她没死 她没听完

clips.name: dlg_H_s1597
lines: [soft, wondering] Death hath had no power yet upon thy beauty.
[tender, quiet] Beauty's ensign yet is crimson in thy lips and in thy cheeks.
[desperate, voice shaking] 红的，是因为她活着！
[calm, tender] Here's to my love!
[breaking] 我只拍，不插……[shouting] 不拍了！
clips.heard: Death have had no power yet upon thy beauty. Beauty's ensign yet is crimson in thy lips and in thy cheeks.红的是因为它活着.Here's to my love.我只拍不差,不拍了!

clips.name: dlg_I_s1597
lines: [waking, drowsy, soft] Where is my Romeo?
[puzzled] Did the friar's letter not reach thee?
[blank] What letter?
[tiny, sheepish] ……拍不了了。我送。
clips.heard: Where is my Romeo? Did the friar's letter not reach thee? What letter? 太不了了 我送
